comparisons.B_vs_A: Current kinetic energy handoff only, same backend amplitude.
comparisons.C_vs_A: Bussi versus Brownian; rigid mask independently tested for unchanged physical trajectories.
comparisons.E_vs_D: CUDA amplitude 2 to 1; CPU physical negative control.
comparisons.F_vs_D: CPU amplitude 1 to 2; CUDA physical negative control.

acceptance.forces: Normalized force and torque error < 1e-3; separate zero-force controls.
acceptance.weak_Bussi: Off-target single-step K change < 0.1% at tau=1e9.
acceptance.rigid_mask: Exactly zero point L; unchanged physical coordinates/velocities at same seed.
acceptance.sampling: Report independent-seed intervals, stationarity and effective sample sizes; no equivalence claim from nonsignificance.
acceptance.performance: Report paired ratios and uncertainty; hold any reproducible slowdown. Five percent is measurement-resolution target, not an authorized slowdown.
acceptance.model_parameters: Sensitivity results, never experimental-accuracy claims without reference data.
acceptance.promotion: No automatic production promotion or parameter choice from these tests.
